title: Master in Public Policy (MPP)
institution: Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy, National University of Singapore
about: The Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy at NUS accepts applications to its Master in Public Policy from 1 August to 15 December each year, by 11:59pm Singapore time. Applicants indicate in their application whether they wish to be considered for a scholarship.
requirements: Applicants wishing to be considered for a school scholarship must indicate it in the application
Application fee waived for the MPP
